annotation.title_clean: The Interweaving and Challenges of Ethics and Technology in Intelligent Elderly Care Robots
annotation.title_en: The Interweaving and Challenges of Ethics and Technology in Intelligent Elderly Care Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Fang, C.; Wu, J.; Du, X.; Xiong, Y.
annotation.venue: Social Medicine and Health Management (Clausius Scientific Press)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese journal article examining ethical and legal issues of intelligent elderly care robots amid population aging, asking whose liberation, responsibility and ethics are at stake. It recommends ethical review, protecting elderly freedom, dignity and privacy, insurance-based responsibility sharing, and improved laws.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ethical review of elderly care robots is warranted.
Protect elderly users' freedom, dignity and privacy.
Shelve the robot subject-status dispute and share responsibility among stakeholders via insurance.
Improve laws and regulations to fill responsibility gaps.
Synchronize social policy with ethical planning, emphasizing human dignity, equity and family care.
